observations: Photo 0 shows a console in clear plastic wrap inside a shop window; only the front/side grille area is visible.
Photo 1 shows the front grille and a small Xbox logo area on the wrapped console; no screen, ports, controller, or power/boot indicators are visible.
No readable model/label/serial number is visible in either photo.

claims.claim: Microsoft Xbox One S All-Digital Edition Console (Disc-free ...)
claims.evidence: Photos only show a wrapped console front grille; no disc-drive presence/absence, model label, or readable 'All-Digital' indicator.

claims.claim: The Xbox One S is a compact (40%...)
claims.evidence: No measurements or model identification visible in the photos.

risks.risk: Wrong console model (e.g., different Xbox generation/variant) or not an Xbox at all.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console label/serial/model number sticker (bottom/back) and the ports area (HDMI, power, USB) with the wrap removed.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic, unverified console (worst case: not confirmed as Xbox One S All-Digital).

risks.risk: Not working / faulty (no boot, no power, overheating, faulty HDMI/power).
risks.proof: Video of power-on showing the boot screen, plus a quick HDMI/TV display confirmation.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working until tested.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, controller) or incomplete bundle.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (console + controller + cables) with a count.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (worst case: no controller/cables).

risks.risk: All-Digital claim may be wrong (could be a disc-drive model).
risks.proof: Photo of the front slot area (should be absent for All-Digital) or a clear view of the disc-drive bay status.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the least favorable variant for the buyer (worst case: not confirmed disc-free).

risks.risk: Region/account lock or prior-owner issues (less common but possible).
risks.proof: Photo/video showing the console reaching the home screen and allowing basic navigation without account lock prompts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially account-locked until proven otherwise.

proof_requests: Remove the plastic wrap and take a clear photo of the console model/serial label (bottom/back).
Take a clear photo of the front area to confirm disc-free (no disc slot) and the exact variant.
Video of power-on to the home screen on a TV (showing HDMI output).
Photo of all included items (controller + power/HDMI cables) laid out.
response.reason: The photos show a wrapped console with an Xbox-like grille/logo, but the exact model/All-Digital status and working condition cannot be confirmed remotely. To price safely, we need the model label and a power-on proof.
